purpose: Describe the National Government's branch-specific economic condition and distinguish nominal manpower from effective defensive/offensive military capacity after Five-Go and continuing Hanzhong-Guangyuan pressure.

historical_1944_anchor: 1943 prices more than trebled and note issue more than doubled; early 1944 price acceleration became very sharp
industrial production was expected to continue falling
branch_structural_worsening_vs_history: greater 1937-38 loss of evacuated factories, skilled workers and transport equipment
Five-Go loss of Tongguan/Xian/Baoji/Hanzhong/Guangyuan-related territory, stocks, tax/transport nodes and forward air geometry
5-7 effective Chinese division-equivalents remain pinned to north-Sichuan defense/route protection
persistent air-defense, runway, fuel, truck and repair allocation tax around Chengdu/Sichuan
branch_offsets_against_collapse: U-Go is NO-GO, so Assam/Hump LOC avoids the historical Imphal emergency
US aid and Hump capacity can support selected high-value military recovery even while macro inflation worsens
Japan does not launch a deep ground drive on Chengdu; the state retains geographic retreat room and core institutions
economic_state.interpretation: The branch is likely worse than historical spring 1944 in domestic real-economy/transport resilience, while the external high-value aid channel is somewhat less threatened because U-Go is absent. This combination sustains the state but does not restore broad offensive capacity.

military_manpower.critical_rule: Do not reduce Chinese national manpower by a single casualty/territory multiplier. The branch damages equipment, cadres, transport, fiscal support and strategic mobility more than the raw pool of recruitable men.
military_manpower.nominal_band_confidence: LOW; package lacks a closed 1944 Nationalist nationwide OOB and historical Chinese rolls were highly inconsistent
military_manpower.formed_field_and_rear_force_character: Hundreds of nominal divisions/brigades remain, many understrength and factionally controlled.
military_manpower.confidence_on_effective_bands: LOW_MEDIUM; intended for allocation logic, not a literal nationwide muster roll

current_fixations_and_free_capacity.hunan_implication: Chongqing can mass substantial local and reinforcement manpower, but cannot convert all nominal divisions into mobile, supplied, artillery-supported field formations at once. Heavy weapons, transport, communications, pay/food and command cohesion are the limiting currencies.

historical_sanity_checks.1943_allied_estimate: over 300 Chinese divisions including Communist divisions, with fewer than one-fifth assessed as fairly reliable sustained defensive troops and fewer offensive-capable
historical_sanity_checks.late_1943_nominal_active_army: 320 infantry and 16 cavalry divisions plus 30 independent infantry brigades in an Allied estimate; average division ~7,000, with very uneven quality
